A04.summary: SHOWN: five fresh save-related packages parse with 36, 9, 4, 88 and 2 exports respectively. BP_AutosaveTrigger.TriggerSave conditionally updates a respawn transform, calls SetLock and SetStats, checks PersistentData.BP_DoesCharacterExistYet and reaches SaveManager.BP_AutoSaveGame with literal byte 3. The unmatched SDK names reason 3 AUTO_SAVE_ALWAYS, but its enum interpretation is not independently build-matched here. The Blueprint call itself is current-build evidence. SHOWN: SetLock reaches LockManagerInterface.SetLock and SetStats reaches StatsManager.SetStat. ProcessTargetActors checks interface support, invokes OnRestoreFromSave, and has actor-destruction and dynamic-object-volume disable/enable routes. BPI_SaveRestore declares both OnRestoreFromSave and OnCheckpointReset. These restore routes are not the serializer. The mod tutorial SaveGame subclass declares three tutorial-completion booleans, which does not establish the campaign save format. SHOWN: dynamic tables distinguish conversation played-count/properties, transient stats, schedules, mail, tutorial queue, story-graph state and event persistence. Some have defaults; many are empty. STATED: MAIN distinguishes unavailable manual saves from possible autosaves, save/load failure, copying an unmodded save to a mod save, and mod repair warnings. This is UI intent, not demonstrated repair. Unmatched SDK declarations expose pre/post-save/load delegates, reason-based blocking and OnDBVersionCheck(SaveVersion,SaveChangeList); they are naming leads only. UNREAD: actual save container/DB embedding, version number, migrations, serializer whitelist, compression/checksum, atomic writes, autosave ring/interval, old-build rejection, corruption recovery and wall-clock/offline policy. No user saves were accessed, and no synthetic file was passed to the game. A shipped SQLite database is not itself proof of SQLite user saves.
yairpg: P3: separate save request, durable completion and restore; docs/ENGINE_SAVES_AND_SCALE_REVIEW_2026-10-11.md
P7: explicit content-version compatibility preview; authoring/save owners
